title: eval-harness: add prompt-set regression CI hook and metrics integration
author: Aisha Patel
description: Add a CI hook that runs prompt-set regression checks against the eval-harness and integrates key eval metrics into our observability pipeline. Motivation: catch prompt-set quality regressions early in the PR flow and prevent bad rollouts; provide deterministic pass/fail gating based on configurable thresholds and export eval metrics (accuracy/precision/recall/coverage/delta) to the metrics backend for dashboards and alerts. The change includes: a GitHub Actions workflow that runs a constrained eval job on PRs touching eval metadata or prompt sets; a lightweight runner script (check_eval_gate.py) that computes gate decisions using the existing eval-harness APIs; integration code to emit metrics to the internal metrics exporter; unit and integration tests; and docs explaining how to author gates. The description below documents what was changed, the CI behavior, and review notes.
commit_summary: Initial CI workflow and runner: add .github/workflows/eval-regression-ci.yml and eval-harness/scripts/check_eval_gate.py
Wire metrics exporter to eval-harness: add send_eval_metrics() helper and config hooks
Add unit tests and fixtures for prompt gate logic
Fix: improve logging and add ENV guard for metrics export (per review feedback)
review_thread: Diego Marquez: Don't export metrics by default — add an opt-in ENV (METRICS_EXPORT_ENABLED).
Aisha Patel: Added ENV guard and documented in the README; updated metrics_exporter to no-op when disabled.
Sofia Ivanov: The gate thresholds look aggressive for smaller prompt sets; can we make thresholds configurable per-prompt-set?
Aisha Patel: Yes, added config in sample_prompt_set.json and fallbacks in gates.py (per-prompt-set override + repo defaults).
Omar Rizwan: Integration test failed due to non-deterministic seed; please make the test deterministic or mark as flakey with retry.
Aisha Patel: Made test deterministic by fixing RNG seed and added retries to the workflow step; reran CI and all checks passed.
merge_commit_message: eval-harness: add prompt-set regression CI hook + metrics integration (squash)
release_notes: Added prompt-set regression CI hook for eval-harness which provides automatic quality gating on PRs that touch prompts or eval configs. Metrics are optionally exported to the observability pipeline when enabled via METRICS_EXPORT_ENABLED. Includes docs and example configs.
notes_for_release: This enables CI-level gating for prompt regressions. Teams must opt-in to metrics export via METRICS_EXPORT_ENABLED and can tune per-prompt-set thresholds in eval-harness/tests/fixtures/sample_prompt_set.json.
changelog_entry: 2026-02-20: eval-harness - add CI prompt-set regression hook and optional metrics integration (Aisha Patel)
additional_context: This PR implements a conservative gate that fails only on statistically significant regressions using bootstrap delta tests; the goal is to reduce false positives in CI while surfacing real regressions. We intentionally limit eval job size in CI (small sample) and rely on Canary/Prod runs for larger datasets. Metrics export uses an existing metrics exporter interface; no new external credentials are introduced — exports are routed through the internal agent when METRICS_EXPORT_ENABLED=1.
